values.name: Concept
values.definition: A general unit of knowledge that doesn't fit a more specific type — an idea, topic, or thing described in prose.

values.name: System
values.definition: A software service, platform, or application that performs a function.

values.name: DataAsset
values.definition: A dataset, table, stream, or other data resource with an owner and a schema.

values.name: Person
values.definition: A human individual referenced as an author, owner, or subject.

values.name: Claim
values.definition: A falsifiable, single-sentence assertion that can be supported, contradicted, or superseded.

values.name: Policy
values.definition: A governance rule or standard that constrains how a system or data asset may be used.

values.name: Runbook
values.definition: A set of steps for performing a recurring operational or maintenance task.
